# `gcp.connection`

A connection to a SCM like GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, Bitbucket Data Center/Cloud or GitLab.

[cloudbuild](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | cloudbuild |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `cloudbuild.googleapis.com/Connection` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |

## What it can do

| Operation | Supported | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Create | yes | `POST projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/connections?connectionId={{name}}` |
| Read | yes | `GET projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/connections/{{name}}` |
| Update | yes | `PATCH projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/connections/{{name}}` |
| Delete | yes | `DELETE projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/connections/{{name}}` |
| Import | yes | by id, see below |

## Import id

Any one of these shapes is accepted, tried in order:

```
projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/connections/{{name}}
{{name}}
```
